recipe.title: Kipper and orange pâté on toast
steps: Put the kippers in a heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water from the kettle and leave for 5 minutes to warm through and soften.
Meanwhile, finely grate the zest of one orange. Cut the peel and pith off both oranges with a sharp knife, then slice them into thin rounds.
Drain the kippers and pat dry. Peel off the skin, pick out any bones you can see and flake the flesh into a mixing bowl.

Add the butter, crème fraîche, horseradish, orange zest and a pinch of paprika. Squeeze in any juice from the orange trimmings and mash with a fork until fairly smooth but still a little rough. Season with black pepper.
Toast the bread. Spread thickly with the pâté, top with the orange slices and a few capers, and finish with the rest of the paprika.
